name: http
lead: Fetches public URLs. The call waits like `task.wait`.

functions.name: get
functions.signature: http.get(url: string, options: {query: {[string]: string }?, headers: {[string]: string }?, timeout: number ?, cache: number ?}?) → HttpResponse
functions.description: GET a URL. `cache` is the seconds a 200 answer is kept on disk; `timeout` is 1 to 60 seconds, 15 by default.

functions.name: socket
functions.signature: http.socket(url: string, options: {headers: {[string]: string }?, on_message: (message: SocketMessage) -> ()}) → Socket
functions.description: Opens a WebSocket (`ws` or `wss`) and keeps it open: when the connection ends, the engine dials again. `on_message` gets each message on a tick.
